10 years ago getting your favourite gadget was an experience, going to shops, discussions, debates and finally you decide to get that dream phone. But now our favourite E Commerce website has wrapped this purchase decision in a shining bright sale!
But how do these platforms, get you to but that stuff in the sale?
In this video we will uncover 4 Dark Patterns that the platforms deploy. You should know these before you decide to make your purchase decision this Sale season!
